inputs.text: South Dakota is doing what a responsible state should: ensuring that people registering to vote in state elections can document their citizenship. Calling a basic safeguard “voter suppression” turns ordinary standards of accountability into a political grievance. The right to vote matters too much to leave confidence in elections weakened; protecting it means respecting the rules and the integrity of the state’s institutions.
